schemas.name: KGDB Mendelian Curation
schemas.description: KGDB gene-disease validity (alpha, draft iteration 8): cited evidence rows, point model, reviewer flags, clinical diagnostics

probands.label: Probands
probands.help_text: One row per unrelated proband whose genotype fits the MOI, scored per allele (SOP v12, max 3); a sib-pair is one proband

variant.label: Variant (HGVS or rsID; AR: v1 / v2)

variant_class.label: Variant class

options.label: Null (LoF: nonsense, frameshift, canonical splice, start loss, deletion)
Loss of function (older rows; use Null)
Splice (older rows; use Null or Splice, other)

variant_class.help_text: The prompt's allele classes; lof and splice are kept for rows entered before iteration 8

alleles.label: Alleles, one entry each: variant | class | nmd_expected | functional_support | functional_pmid | functional_quote | also_scored_as_experimental
alleles.help_text: Two entries for a recessive genotype (a homozygote lists the allele twice); class null, missense, inframe, splice_other or other. Null 1.5 (1.0 when nmd_expected is false), other 0.1 or 0.5 with functional support

zygosity.label: Zygosity
zygosity.help_text: Required: the allele-frequency cutoff keys on it (heterozygous/hemizygous 1e-4, otherwise 2.5e-3)

phase.label: Phase (required for compound het)
phase.help_text: Unknown or blank on a compound het: GC halves the row's points; do not halve them yourself

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the abstract, passage or ClinVar text that supports the row; no quote, no points

points.label: Points
points.help_text: Enter the full allele sum (SOP v12), max 3; GC halves a compound het with unknown phase (x0.5) and caps a consanguineous homozygote at 2. Blank: the default (1) or the row rules

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

segregation.label: Segregation
segregation.help_text: One row for the entity: summed LOD of families that reach the minimum (AR >=3 affected, AD >=4 segregations); 2 / 3 / 5 -> 1 / 2 / 3 points

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the abstract, passage or ClinVar text that supports the row; no quote, no points

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

cohort.label: Cohort (case-control / burden)
cohort.help_text: A significant case-control or burden study

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the abstract, passage or ClinVar text that supports the row; no quote, no points

points.label: Points
points.help_text: Leave blank for the default (2) or the row rules

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

models.label: Models
models.help_text: Animal or cell model whose kidney or urinary-tract phenotype matches (lower urinary tract counts)

options.label: Partial (e.g. KO for an AD LoF entity)

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the abstract, passage or ClinVar text that supports the row; no quote, no points

points.label: Points
points.help_text: Leave blank for the default (2) or the row rules

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

functional.label: Functional
functional.help_text: One row per line of evidence: function 0.5, functional alteration 1 (patient cells) or 0.5, rescue 2

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the abstract, passage or ClinVar text that supports the row; no quote, no points

points.label: Points
points.help_text: Leave blank for the subtype's default

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

contradictory_evidence.label: Contradictory evidence
contradictory_evidence.help_text: Disputed or refuted sets the class and needs the reviewer's attention

description.label: Counter-evidence
description.help_text: High allele frequency, non-segregation, adequate non-replication, model without phenotype, non-significant case-control. Lack of evidence is not contradictory

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

replicated_over_time.label: Replicated over time
replicated_over_time.help_text: >=3 years since the first report and >=2 later papers from independent groups (one multicentre series = one paper)

reported_not_scored.label: Reported, not scored
reported_not_scored.help_text: Probands claimed in papers that could not be verified (count + PMIDs)

context_notes.label: Context (never scored)
context_notes.help_text: STRING, GTEx/Descartes, MGI and other gene-level context

reviewer_flags.label: Reviewer flags
reviewer_flags.help_text: Calculated class differs from your call; near a band edge; experimental above genetic; >= 50% of genetic points from <= 2 variants; susceptibility; unchecked AF on a point-carrying variant; key paper unread

detectability_note.label: Detectability note
detectability_note.help_text: e.g. standard short-read testing adequate (CNV calling recommended)

legacy_transcript.label: Legacy transcript used in the literature

detectability.label: Detectability
detectability.help_text: Why standard short-read testing can miss variants; leave empty when nothing special is known

tools.label: Tools, one entry each: name | url | PMID or DOI

negative_report_does_not_exclude.label: A negative report does not exclude

resources.label: Resources
resources.help_text: Only URLs that were fetched and match their description

refseq_format.message: RefSeq: NM_ with version, e.g. NM_006580.4

ensembl_format.message: Ensembl: ENST with version, e.g. ENST00000264734.3

sections.name: Probands
sections.help_text: Per allele (SOP v12): null 1.5, other 0.1 / 0.5 with functional support, de novo confirmed +0.5; enter the full allele sum, max 3 per proband, cap 12; GC halves unknown phase (x0.5), caps a consanguineous homozygote at 2 and a recurrent variant at 3 per population

sections.name: Models
sections.help_text: Default 2 (1 for a partial mechanism fit or morpholino only), cap 4

sections.name: Functional
sections.help_text: Function 0.5 each (biochemical, interaction, expression; cap 2), functional alteration patient cells 1 / non-patient 0.5 (cap 2), rescue 2; category cap 4

bands.description: Total score of at least 11.5 points (at least 4 genetic) with replication over time supports a DEFINITIVE gene-disease relationship.
Total score of at least 11.5 points (at least 4 genetic) supports a STRONG gene-disease relationship.
Total score of 6.5 to 11.4 points (at least 4 genetic) supports a MODERATE gene-disease relationship.
Some genetic evidence, below 6.5 points or too little for a higher class: a LIMITED gene-disease relationship.
No genetic points, whatever the experimental evidence: NO KNOWN disease relationship.

tests.name: CLDN16 (AR HOMG3): 10 probands + 6 experimental, replicated
NEK8 (AD ADPKD): 12 genetic + 2 experimental, not replicated
SIX5 (AD BOR): contradictory evidence disputes it

contradictory_evidence.description: Variants too common in gnomAD and fail to segregate

tests.name: DNAJB11-like: genetic 2 + experimental 6 = 8 stays Limited (genetic >= 4 for Moderate+)
Hotspot: 6 probands with one recurrent variant score 3 (group cap)
Compound het without a phase scores half (0.5 when blank; only confirmed or suspected count fully)
A row without zygosity scores 0 (the AF cutoff needs it)
Row rules: de novo 1.5, phase unknown 0.5, not_given/duplicate/AF/no PMID 0, AR AF below 2.5e-3 counts; models partial and morpholino 1
Iteration 8: per-allele rows up to 3, Strong from 11.5; a row without a quote scores 0
Functional subtypes: expression and interaction 0.5, patient cells 1, rescue 2, cap 4; no genetic points is No Known
Iteration 8 rules: unknown phase halves entered points, consanguineous homozygote at most 2 (6.5 is Moderate)
Recurrent variant capped at 3 per population: 3 x 1.5 in Japan + 2 x 1.5 in Finland
Functional sub-caps: 6 expression rows score 2 (function cap 2); entered 1 on non-patient cells scores 0.5

schemas.name: KGDB Susceptibility Curation
schemas.description: Susceptibility (risk allele) curation (alpha, approved by KGDB on 2026-10-31, kidney-genetics-db#473): Established / Likely / Uncertain / Refuted association, off the Mendelian bands

studies.label: Association studies
studies.help_text: One row per independent study of one named risk allele or haplotype; OR and 95% CI oriented to that allele. Not significant after correction, included in a meta-analysis or protective scores 0

evidence_quote.label: Evidence quote (<= 40 words, verbatim)
evidence_quote.help_text: Copied from the source that supports the row

significant_after_correction.label: Significant after multiple-testing correction
significant_after_correction.help_text: GWAS p < 5e-8; false or blank scores 0

effect_direction.label: Effect direction
effect_direction.help_text: Protective is recorded, not scored (0). An OR < 1 for the curated risk allele is contradictory evidence

included_in.label: Included in meta-analysis (study label)
included_in.help_text: Set when this cohort is part of a meta-analysis row; scores 0 so it is not counted twice

points.label: Points
points.help_text: Leave blank for the default (1; 2 if >=50 cases and >=50 controls; 3 if >=500 and >=500 or a meta-analysis); enter fewer for bias or poor ancestry matching

sources.label: Sources
sources.help_text: Where the row comes from: PMID, DOI, ClinVar (VCV/RCV/SCV), ClinGen allele (CA) or validity (CGGV), URL or database record, with the tool and retrieval date (VA-Spec reportedIn)

sections.name: Association studies
sections.help_text: Default 1 / 2 / 3 by study size or meta-analysis, cap 9

bands.description: At least 6 association points and the ClinGen Very Strong criteria support an ESTABLISHED association.
At least 4 association points (a discovery study plus a replication) support a LIKELY association.
Significant but small, unreplicated or conflicting association evidence: the association is UNCERTAIN.

tests.name: Established: two large significant studies, ClinGen Very Strong
Likely: a large discovery study and a mid-sized replication, not Very Strong
Uncertain: a small significant study; not significant after correction, or blank, scores 0
Refuted: refuting evidence overrides an established score

contradictory_evidence.description: Well-powered meta-analysis of >500 cases and >500 controls does not replicate the association

tests.name: Meta-analysis: its included cohorts are not counted again
Protective: a large protective study is recorded, not scored
Uncertain: functional data alone never move the class
Likely: 9 association points without ClinGen Very Strong
Uncertain: functional points do not lift association to a band (section_min)
Uncertain: disputed evidence overrides an established score

contradictory_evidence.description: Large cohort with the OR oriented against the allele

tests.name: Size tiers: a blank p value scores by size; 50/50 and 500/500 are inclusive, 600/40 stays at 1
Likely: Very Strong, but functional points do not complete Established (section_min)
